title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 sneaker was first revealed at the Yeezy Season 3 fashion show and released in September 2016. The 'Antlia Non-Reflective' model reprises the design, covering the shoe's Primeknit upper with a pale yellow-green hue. A translucent stripe lines the lateral side, which leads to the back where the traditional heel tab has been removed. This region-exclusive colorway released June 2019 alongside a similar 'Reflective' version. As is standard in all Boost 350 models, full-length adidas Boost cushioning is encapsulated in a wrapped TPU shell that extends from the midsole to the outsole.

title: HD-10 MEXICO
description:
Background: Designed by Ye, Taha Elghanai, and Muad Elghanai, based on Fostex’s Army Physical Training Zip Up, the HD-10 was made in Spain on 05/15/2025. The fit and overall design were later updated on 05/30/2025. 

Taha Elghanai and Ye hand-pressed the first version together, with Ye personally hand-placing the print location. This process also marked the creation of the Black version. The Black version originally featured the text “Cuck,” which was later changed back to “SZN X.” 

This version was released at a Yeezy Pop Up at Copenhague 27Juárez, Cuauhtémoc, 06600 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico by Tiempos Shop (@tiempos.shop on Instagram), featured a price increase to $100, just like other Mexico Merch. It is 100% cotton as opposed to ones sold on yeezy.com, and is made in Mexico.

title: LS-03 FLAG
description:
Background: Designed by Mark Seekings with a graphic either designed or referenced from Gosha Rubchinsky, the LS-03 FLAG was released online at bully.yeezy.com/collections/sofi on the day of the first concert.

The LS-03 features an updated logo compared to the Mexico release, with a Chinese flag replacing the Mexico flag, "YE LIVE IN CALIFORNIA" printed beneath it, and "LOS ANGELES 04 01/03 26" printed on the back of the neck.

The release also featured a price increase, with the shirt selling for $75 compared to its original $20 price on yeezy.com. It was also made in the USA.
